issues.title: style: handle empty input array in `FindMin.findMin`
issues.body:
<!-- For completed items, change [ ] to [x] -->
The current implementation of the method [`findMin`](https://github.com/TheAlgorithms/Java/blob/e14b30b88c0de95186fe1937f795b7d8fd3fa8aa/src/main/java/com/thealgorithms/maths/FindMin.java#L32) has some issues:
- all of the [existing test cases](https://github.com/TheAlgorithms/Java/blob/e14b30b88c0de95186fe1937f795b7d8fd3fa8aa/src/test/java/com/thealgorithms/maths/FindMinTest.java) have the minimum at index 0,
- it crashed for empty input.

In this PR, I:
- added missing test cases 982b296e1ffffb5042c05d018f2a94743d8c88ff,
- make `findMin` throw `IllegalArgumentException` when input is empty 548e1aa1043b337da160974403ab03a0ad9c9c67,
- do some minor style changes and update the documentation.

As in #4199 I decided not to create a separate issue for this - I hope this is not a problem.

issues.body:
<!-- For completed items, change [ ] to [x] -->

This PR is analogous to #4205. The method [`FindMax.findMax`](https://github.com/TheAlgorithms/Java/blob/4f1514980495c4daaae2eb060228a87e14cbae11/src/main/java/com/thealgorithms/maths/FindMax.java#L32) crashes for empty input.

This PR:
- adds _missing_ test cases,
- makes `findMax` to throw `IllegalArgumentException` for empty input,
- updates the implementation and doc string to be consistent with [`FindMin.findMin`](https://github.com/TheAlgorithms/Java/blob/4f1514980495c4daaae2eb060228a87e14cbae11/src/main/java/com/thealgorithms/maths/FindMin.java#L33)

issues.title: fix: handle inputs like `"2 +"` in `StackPostfixNotation`
issues.body:
After #4261 was merged, I have realized that the method [`StackPostfixNotation.postfixEvaluate`](https://github.com/vil02/Java/blob/44dcebb6996b39b5a1a67a8633f95b6e4c1bd0f0/src/main/java/com/thealgorithms/others/StackPostfixNotation.java#L11) still does not handle properly all of the inputs (e. g. `"2 +"` or `"+"`). This PR fixes that.
